summary: A view menu with two checkbox items and a radio group for the sort order, kept open while options change, with the current state shown below.
use: Menus that set view options: toggles (show hidden, show preview) and one choice among several (sort by).
spec: Two `<DropdownMenuCheckboxItem bind:checked={showHidden}>` style items (`bind:checked={showPreview}`): Show hidden files and Show preview
`<DropdownMenuSeparator />` then `<DropdownMenuRadioGroup bind:value={sort} aria-label="Sort by">` with a `DropdownMenuLabel` and radio items name, date, size
`aria-live="polite"` note reports `Sorted by {sort}` and the two toggles
